claim.quote: This leads to the most stringent upper limits on WIMP-neutron cross sections for WIMP masses above 6 GeV, with a minimum cross section of 3.5 x 10^{-40} cm^2 at a WIMP mass of 45 GeV, at 90% confidence level.

key_value.note: WIMP-neutron spin-dependent limit minimum, 90% CL, 45 GeV.
key_value.quote: a minimum cross section of 3.5 x 10^{-40} cm^2 at a WIMP mass of 45 GeV, at 90% confidence level

name: Limits on spin-dependent WIMP-nucleon cross sections from 225 live days of XENON100 data

summary.plain: Using the same data, XENON100 also tested WIMPs that interact through spin and again saw no signal.
summary.technical: 224.6 live days x 34 kg exposure (2011-2012): no excess signal from axial-vector WIMP interactions with 129-Xe and 131-Xe nuclei; WIMP-neutron minimum cross section 3.5e-40 cm^2 at 45 GeV (90% CL).

title: Limits on spin-dependent WIMP-nucleon cross sections from 225 live days of XENON100 data
why_it_matters: Reported as the most stringent WIMP-neutron limit for masses above 6 GeV at the time.
